Definition & Calculation Logic: Unique identifier for each patient (1 row per patient, N=500).
Patient age in years (most recent valid record, KNN-imputed if missing).
Patient gender (Female, Male, Other); standardized to most recent visit.
Patient city of residence across 8 UK/Irish cities.
Patient occupation (standardized to most recent visit; <18 set to Student).
Provider A, B, C, D, or 'Uninsured' for patients with no policy.
Recorded family medical history (Cancer, Diabetes, Heart Disease, Hypertension, None).
Highest educational attainment (Pre-school to PhD; KNN-imputed).
Marital status (Single, Married, Divorced, Widowed; standardized).
Mean cleaned annual income (£) across patient consultations.
10-year age bracket (0-9, 10-19, ..., 90+) for demographic segmentation.
Patient income quartile (Q1 Lowest to Q4 Highest).
Total number of hospital consultations between Jan 1 and Jun 30, 2024.
Number of unique hospital departments visited by the patient.
Modal (most frequently visited) department for the patient.
Mean consultation duration in minutes (post-IQR Winsorization).
Cumulative consultation duration in minutes across all visits.
Count of consultations occurring on Saturday or Sunday.
Count of consultations occurring Monday through Friday.
Ratio of weekend visits to weekday visits (Weekend / max(1, Weekday)).
Proportion of total visits occurring on weekends.
Cumulative gross consultation cost (£) across all visits.
Mean gross price (£) per consultation.
Cumulative amount (£) covered and paid by the insurance provider.
Mean insurance coverage amount (£) per consultation.
Total out-of-pocket expenditure (£) paid by the patient (Price - Coverage).
Mean out-of-pocket cost (£) per consultation.
Share of total consultation price paid out-of-pocket by the patient.
Mean consultation satisfaction score (1 = lowest, 5 = highest).
Minimum satisfaction rating recorded across any visit.
Maximum satisfaction rating recorded across any visit.
Total count of dissatisfied visits with rating <= 2.
Proportion of patient visits rated <= 2 (dissatisfaction rate).
Days elapsed from the patient's first visit to July 1, 2024.
Days elapsed from the patient's most recent visit to July 1, 2024.
Number of days between the patient's first and last recorded visit.
Average monthly consultation frequency over the 6-month period (Total_Visits / 6).
